sonnet.problem: The setup rules out the wrong answers. Card 12 says Ahab is badly wounded, and card 13 says his blood runs out onto the floor of the chariot. That makes 'recovers' and 'escapes' obviously wrong, so the question can be answered without reading verse 35.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: 'Jehoshaphat king of Judah' is already a wrong answer on card 10, and Judah is a wrong answer on card 4. Card 20 uses it as a wrong answer again.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
